case_title: MESCHAC GERVAIS VS. VALMOR NETO ET AL

docket_entries.description: DECLARATION RE: RESET OF COURT DATE TO ADVANCE HEARING RE: PROGRESS REPORT FILED BY PLAINTIFF GERVAIS, MESCHAC
TRIAL RESET TO JUL-15-2016 AT 10:00 AM IN DEPT 506 TRIAL OF AUG-05-2016 IS TAKEN OFF CALENDAR

SMALL CLAIMS CALENDAR OF JUL-15-2016 - TAKEN UNDER SUBMISSION AS OF JUL-15-2016 BY DONALD S. MITCHELL. APPEARANCE BY PLAINTIFF MESCHAC GERVAIS. NO APPEARANCE BY DEFENDANTS VALMOR NETO OR SANDRA MARIA SILVA RAMOS. PROOF OF SERVICE IN THE FILE AS TO BOTH DEFENDANTS. MATTER IS ON TODAY'S CALENDAR FOR A PROGRESS REPORT AS THE PARTIES REACHED AN AGREEMENT AT THE LAST CALLING OF THE CASE. DEFENDANTS HAVE BREACHED THE AGREEMENT. PLAINTIFF HAS NOT RECEIVED ANY PAYMENTS SINCE MARCH 2, 2016. EXHIBITS NOT RETAINED. JUDGE: DONALD S. MITCHELL. CLERK: K. DOUGHERTY. NOT REPORTED. (D506).
SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF JUL-15-2016 - JUDGMENT.

THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF GERVAIS, MESCHAC RECOVER FROM DEFENDANT NETO, VALMOR SILVA RAMOS, SANDRA MARIA $500.00 PRINCIPAL, $60.00 COSTS, TOTAL JUDGMENT $560.00 STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS NO EXHIBITS FILED
